changelog: ### v1.1.0b3 - Harmonic spread & Advanced Settings (beta)
> Beta for testers. Changes since v1.0.8. Defaults match v1.0.8 (gain 1.00×, scale off, expo spread), so a fresh install sounds the same until you change something.
**New Features**

- **Advanced Settings menu** — holds three settings: modulator gain, scale, spread mode. Enter by holding SET for 5s from the main view, or holding SET at power-on. Encoder moves between rows, touchwheel changes the value, a single SET click saves and exits.

- **Harmonic spread mode** — alternative satellite spread law. At full spread from 100 Hz, "expo" stacks octaves (100/200/400/800), "harmonic" follows the harmonic series (100/200/300/400); identical at zero spread. Toggle expo/harmonic on the mode row.

- **Scale quantization** — snaps each satellite's pitch to a scale. "off" (default) disables it and matches v1.0.x; "chromatic" snaps to 12-TET semitones; other built-ins: octaves, fifths, major, minor, pentatonic.

- **Custom scales** — a `/scales.txt` on the Daisy SD card defines up to 15 scales, one per line as `name = 0,2,4,5,7,9,11` (semitone offsets 0–11); `#` and blank lines ignored. The file replaces the built-in scales ("off" always stays).
- **Modulator gain** — 0.00×–2.00× modulator level (default 1.00×), applied to the audio and the on-screen spectrum.
**Behavior Changes**
- Holding SET now opens Advanced Settings (5s from main, or at power-on). The hold-SET save prompt is restricted to the Datum Manager.
- Advanced settings persist across power cycles.
- Touchwheel in Advanced Settings advances ~4–5 steps per full rotation.
- Menu shows real scale names instead of numbers.
**Notes for testers**
- Updates both ESP32 and Daisy firmware — flash the full bundle.
- Harmonic filter tracking is still being tuned; A/B the two modes and report which feels better.
**Technical Details**
- Built from commit: 03e7db3
- Build date: 2026-07-09
### v1.0.8 - Persistent settings, filter-bank Key CV & TIME CV
**New Features**
- Orbit settings (speed + mult) persistence
- Warp settings persistence
- Spectral table slot assignment persistence (without saving)
- Save up to 64 spectral tables
- Key CV affects filter banks (previously only affected internal oscillators)
- Naptime animation spawns after 5 mins of no human interaction (touch wheel, buttons, pot, encoder)
- Updated button action to reset time offsets - long press satellite button
- Updated button action to reset orbit mult - long press orbit encoder
**Improvements**
- Improved TIME CV response (0-5V corresponds to a full lap + no drift)
- Improved save procedure
- Improved spectral table handling
- Improved satellite playhead stability at rest (no more jitter)
- Improved audio stability
- Tuned orbit encoder response
**Technical Details**
- Built from commit: edfa964
- Build date: 2026-07-08
### v1.0.0 - First Production Release
**New Features**
- Datum Manager UI with smooth list scrolling, orbit playhead, inactivity timeout, and loaded-datum jump
- 8 built-in algorithmic datum presets (VCA, Mirror, Chirp, Binary, Harmonic, etc.) filling all default slots
- Datum preview system with real LUT preset loading, interpolation, and 30Hz refresh
- Health diagnostics system with audio loopback test tone for calibration jig
- OTA verbose error info — error reason displayed on OTA progress screen
- Screen centering adjustment integrated into Calibration scene with NVS persistence
**Improvements**
- Scanner CV remapped: reversed positive range, permutation-chained negative range
- Lens pot curve improved for better control feel
- LED brightness halved globally; REC input LED turns off when nothing connected
- Audio LED fix for accurate level display
- Comprehensive unit test suite (57+ tests) covering DatumManager, persistence, protocol dispatch
- Code quality sweep: extracted CommService, CallbackHandlers, and engine logic from main.cpp; replaced volatile with std::atomic
- Removed `Serial.setDebugOutput` and unused temporary variables from production build
- SD card firmware cleanup on boot to prevent bootloader auto-flash revert
**Bug Fixes**
- Fixed SRAM overflow on Daisy (106.92% to 79.42%) by moving LUT arrays to SDRAM
- Fixed satellite position wiggle when orbit rate is zero
- Fixed DatumManager orbit playhead draw order and visibility
- Fixed encoder bounce and missed detents with halfQuad accumulator
- Fixed datum list-request race condition with retry on dropped initial send
- Fixed PWM range limiting to avoid silence at extremes
- Fixed C_List culling, centering, and selection offset
- Fixed boot timing and audio loopback probe detection
- Fixed CI build (octal version constant, ESP32 font path, ARM GCC pinning)
**Technical Details**
- Built from commit: 06b8e58
- Build date: 2026-03-28
